fusions.name: Out of the Shell
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Darts your head out of your shell for a bite that deals 20 damage, consumes every affliction on the target and adds 1.2 times their remaining damage to the hit. It has 50% more critical chance against anything not yet wounded.

fusions.name: Spun Upside Down
fusions.desc: You spin on the dome of your shell, which deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Each hit has a 25% chance to turn the target against its allies for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Empty-Shell Ruse
fusions.desc: Veils you for 5 seconds and heals you for 10 health. Enemies notice you far later and you move 15% faster; the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: After Lamplight
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%. Your armour rises by 6% at all times.
